title: Desk Guidance: Unrepaid Property-Charge Advances on a First Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Unrepaid advances.** For the first extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case whose borrower has died, the unrepaid property-charge advances are the advances recorded on the loan's property charge repayment arrangement (the Property Charge Advance Repayment record), less the repayments recorded on it.

**Rule.**

- Where they exceed 2000.00 dollars and the loan's Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve is not active, 10 calendar days are taken off the extension length.
- Where they are more than zero and no more than 2000.00 dollars and that reserve is not active, 5 calendar days are taken off it.
- Where there are none, or that reserve is active, nothing is taken off.

The reserve is the Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve for that loan among the borrower's Set-Aside Accounts. Any status other than active, or no such reserve, counts as not active.

| Unrepaid advances | Reserve active? | Days taken off the extension length |
|---|---|---|
| above 2000.00 dollars | no | 10 |
| above zero, at most 2000.00 dollars | no | 5 |
| none | either | 0 |
| any | yes | 0 |

## Both sides (hypothetical)

- Advances of 4,000.00 with repayments of 2,000.00 leave 2000.00 dollars unrepaid. With the reserve not active, 5 days are taken off.
- Advances of 4,000.00 with repayments of 1,500.00 leave 2,500.00 dollars unrepaid. With the reserve not active, 10 days are taken off.
